sections.Profile:
The Flintstones, released by Innovative Concepts in Entertainment (ICE) in 1994, is a solid-state pinball machine themed around the popular animated television series. The game features a distinctive cabinet design resembling the Flintstones' iconic stone-age car, enhancing its visual appeal. Equipped with three flippers and a dot matrix display (DMD), the machine offers engaging gameplay elements, including various ramps, targets, and multiball modes that capture the prehistoric antics of Fred Flintstone and his family. As a redemption game, it also includes a coin-operated ticket vendor, allowing players to earn tickets based on their performance.

- Manufacturer: Innovative Concepts (ICE)
- Years made: 1994
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 1
